title: He Could Read Tiny Print Clearly, Yet His Own Face in a Mirror Looked Like a Stranger
description:
You think sharp eyesight guarantees knowing your own face! Yet one soldier saw a stranger in his mirror! This is the true story of Joachim Bodamer's Face Blindness. Here is what went wrong with our idea of sight.
